newsitem.title: USA: US late spot prods soar with futures, diffs mixed.
newsitem.headline: US late spot prods soar with futures, diffs mixed.

text.p: U.S. spot products soared with January NYMEX futures late Monday, traders said, with differentials narrowly mixed in lackluster activity amid a dearth of major market news.

New York Harbor heating oil diffs were stable at about 0.10 cent over the January print in the face of a new Smith Barney forecast of a prolonged cold snap bringing much-below normal temperatures to the Midwest by midweek and to the Northeast by the weekend.
Gulf Coast heat diffs were also little changed at about 5.0 cents below the print as January futures raced 3.11 cents higher, helped by anticipation of the cold weather.

On the gasoline front, a downed fluid catalytic cracker at Tosco Corp's Bayway refinery in New Jersey has returned to "over 50 percent of its usual output," a source familiar with the refinery operations told Reuters Monday.
The giant 140,000 barrel per day cracker was put out of action Wednesday night after a small fire at the unit's relief valve and was tested last Friday for a possible return to operation.
"It's continuing to ramp up production and is running along well," the source said.
